name: Daily Taiwan Eligible Async Remote Job Hunter

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: Edit these values before activating the workflow.

parameters.content:
## Steps 1-2: Trigger & Sources
RemoteOK + Remotive use free JSON APIs. We Work Remotely + Himalayas use RSS (no auth needed).

Wellfound, Dynamite Jobs, YC Work at a Startup and Otta do NOT expose a public API/RSS and actively block plain scraping. The 'Other Sources Placeholder' node returns an empty list until you wire up a scraping service (Apify, Browserless, ScrapingBee) there — see README.

## Steps 3-9: Taiwan Eligibility, AI Check, Async & Role Fit
Keyword match -> dedupe vs Google Sheets -> hard keyword filter (US/EU/hybrid/etc reject list vs worldwide/anywhere/contractor allow list) -> Claude AI Taiwan-eligibility check -> async-hours filter -> role fit tagging.

Any stage can kick a job to the Rejected sheet. Everything that survives moves on to scoring.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ (() => { const job = $json; const promptText = 'You are filtering remote jobs for Jerry, who lives in Taiwan.

The most important rule: Jerry must be able to work this job while physically based in Taiwan. Do not pass the job only because it says "remote".

Reject the job if it requires the worker to live in the US, Canada, UK, EU, Europe, Australia, or any specific country outside Taiwan. Reject the job if it requires local work authorization outside Taiwan. Reject the job if it is hybrid, onsite, or remote within one country only. Reject the job if it requires fixed working hours that would force Jerry to work through the night in Taiwan.

Keep the job only if one of these is true: worldwide remote; work from anywhere; global remote; APAC remote; allows international contractors; accepts people based anywhere; hires through EOR, Deel, Remote.com, Oyster, or contractor agreement.

Return JSON only in this exact shape, no markdown, no extra text:
{"taiwan_eligible":"yes/no/unclear","reason":"short reason","location_risk":"low/medium/high","timezone_risk":"low/medium/high","contractor_possible":"yes/no/unclear","decision":"keep/reject/manual_check"}

Job post:
' + (job.description || job.job_title || ''); return JSON.stringify({ model: $('Config').item.json.anthropicModel, max_tokens: 300, messages: [ { role: 'user', content: promptText } ] }); })() }}

parameters.content:
## Steps 10, 14-15: Scoring & Final Decision
0-100 score = Taiwan fit (up to 40) + async fit (up to 25) + role fit (up to 25) + salary (up to 25).
Keep only score >= 70. Instant alert + cover letter draft at score >= 85.

Final Decision Logic enforces the one-sentence rule: if it fails 'work from Taiwan, no relocation, no destroyed sleep', it gets force-rejected regardless of score.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ (() => { const j = $json; const bg = 'Bilingual English and Mandarin. Grew up in California and Taiwan. Digital marketing background. Data science bootcamp experience. Python, SQL, Tableau, Power BI. Performance marketing, SEO, PPC, GA4, Meta Ads, Google Ads. AI tools: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor. Experience with dashboards, EDA, machine learning projects, customer segmentation, fraud detection, and marketing analytics.'; const prompt = 'Write a short cover letter for Jerry. Jerry is based in Taiwan and wants async global remote work. Use this background: ' + bg + ' Make the letter specific to this job: ' + j.job_title + ' at ' + j.company + '. Job description: ' + j.description + '. Mention how Jerry can help the company: reduce manual analysis time, improve reporting speed, connect marketing and data, build AI-assisted workflows, turn messy data into business action. Keep it under 220 words. Tone: confident, direct, human, not desperate.'; return JSON.stringify({ model: $('Config').item.json.anthropicModel, max_tokens: 500, messages: [ { role: 'user', content: prompt } ] }); })() }}

parameters.content:
## Steps 11-13: Sheets, Instant Alert, Cover Letter & Daily Digest
Logs to 3 tabs this workflow writes to: Raw Jobs, Filtered Jobs, Rejected. Create the 'Applied' tab manually — you update it yourself when you actually apply, this workflow never auto-applies.

Score >= 85 triggers a Telegram alert + a Gmail cover-letter draft (draft only — nothing is sent or submitted automatically).

The daily digest re-reads today's rows from Filtered Jobs + Rejected after every branch finishes writing, so counts are always accurate.
